leaders_covered: Festus Mogae; Ian Khama; Mokgweetsi Masisi
notes: Probe-validated 2026-07-27: 91 speech files. Botswana publishes speeches as FILES (PDF + Word .docx/.doc) scattered across the gov.bw /Global/ (pre-2017) and /globalassets/ (post-migration) trees - under OP Ministry / op-ministry (Office of the President: State of the Nation Addresses + President/VP speeches), Portal Team / portal-team/speeches and the budget-speech folders. No single clean prefix + the engine can't crawl an archived listing, so the recipe harvests ALL gov.bw document captures (content_type: pdf; wayback_filter = mimetype regex for pdf|msword|docx) and keeps the speech-keyword subset via link_pattern. The engine now extracts all three types (.docx = stdlib, dependency-free; .doc = antiword/catdoc if on PATH else skipped cleanly; PDF = pdfminer). Verified: PDFs 637-179,572 chars (SONA, Budget Speeches); .docx 'SPEECH BY HIS EXCELLENCY ... IAN KHAMA, PRESIDENT ... JOINT SESSION OF THE NAMIBIAN PARLIAMENT' (6.2k); .doc via antiword 'Statement by Minister Masisi ... UNDP' (6.9k). Presidents Festus Mogae (1998-2008), Ian Khama (2008-2018), Mokgweetsi Masisi (2018- ) + VP + Finance Minister (budget); NO speaker_default -> cleaner + tenure crosscheck. A few keyword false positives (e.g. 'Civil and National Registration') dropped by the document_type gate. FULL RUN is the researcher's gate.
